decisions.rationale: SR-009 scenario 1 (send_at refused without tx_time) is verified on a real kernel. Scenario 2 needs the sch_etf qdisc, which the local Docker kernel lacks; the test exists, skips there by name, and runs in the ubuntu-24.04 CI lane on every push. The residual risk is a launch-time frame dropped without being counted, which only affects callers who opt into SO_TXTIME.
